items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I played Espinade and Dolphine from Miss Claiborne Williams... We played the big dance and that for them.

ctx.x: Most all my job work like that. That's like private parties.

That's right, that's right. Now, we got, you know, I got me coming, um, about two Saturdays from now, I'm going over to Lake, at the concert club over there. They said, Louis concert club, I used to go over there before. Well, the man had it, what he's paying for a good price and all, well, like I told the man, he had asked me, could I have more pieces? I told him, he's all right with me. He wants, I used to go over there with six, he wanted to bring eight. So, last time we went, he said, Julie, you better bring…
I'm playing, but I went, you know, over there in the back when you laughed at her.
